name: Back with an accent
setupLines: Genteel and Jaunty arrive in matching outfits. Gentle, two tables away, pretends not to see.
"Before we judge costumes," says Generous, "everyone looks wonderful." Nobody believes Generous.
A puff of smoke drifts past the table. Several guests cough pointedly.

genteel: Genteel knew him in France. Ask her, politely.
Genteel has opinions about his costume. Only in mockery, of course.
Ask Genteel. She's been dying to.
jaunty: Jaunty knows exactly where that costume came from.
Ask Jaunty. He'll do the accent.
Jaunty was there when the costume first went on.
generous: Generous has been covering for him for centuries. Ask how long.
Ask Generous. She'll say nothing unkind, which tells you plenty.
Generous knows the date. Generous always knows the date.
naive: Naive believes the lamp story. Ask her what doesn't add up.
Ask Naive. She noticed something without meaning to.
Naive asked him a question. He didn't answer it.
puny: Nobody tells Puny anything, so Puny listens. Ask him.
Puny overheard something at the academics' table.
Ask Puny. He's furious about it, whatever it is.
